title: Fire Emblem 8 terrain tables (data/terrains.json)
description: Terrain-indexed data from the decomp's src/data_terrains.c. 'entries' has exactly one row per terrain id (position = id, TERRAIN_COUNT = 65); 'tables' maps decomp symbol names to 65-value s8 tables (movement costs, avoid/def/res bonuses, battle-animation ground/background lookups).

game.description: Game whose ROM this table was extracted from. Formats are shared by the GBA Fire Emblem games (docs/decisions/0010-multi-game-reuse.md); game-specific values are allowed only where the schema says so.

healAmount.description: HP healed per turn, in percent of max HP (GetTerrainHealAmount).

healsStatus.description: Cures status ailments at turn start (GetTerrainHealsStatus).
